name: Intruder wounded in the repair shed
description: Round two after Halla spent Luck to reverse the Knight parry 57 to75. Halla attack62/81 succeeds, Choose Location sends the existing3 damage to the unarmored head. Knight Head is3/6. Initiative remains Knight before Halla.
summary: Halla stopped a Dragon Knight caught planting a tarred parcel beneath a repair hull. After wounding him in the head and seriously disabling his left arm, Halla accepted his surrender and took him into the house. Halla is uninjured; the Knight is unarmed and compliant. Broadsword remains on shed floor; parcel remains beside the opened hull.
